source_caption:
The future is no longer ours.

One of the greatest sci-fi universes ever created is finally returning. From Ridley Scott’s groundbreaking Blade Runner (1982) to Denis Villeneuve’s visually stunning Blade Runner 2049 (2017), the franchise has redefined what science fiction can look and feel like.

Now, 50 years after the events of 2049, everything has changed. Humanity is no longer in control, and the Replicants have taken over.

Starring Michelle Yeoh and Hunter Schafer, with original director Ridley Scott returning as executive producer, Blade Runner 2099 takes us deeper into a world where the line between human and machine has never been more blurred.

All eight episodes premiere November 25, exclusively on @PrimeVideo.

Are you ready to return to the world of Blade Runner?
